Items.Name: Firefly
Items.Description: Enable fireflies to spawn naturally when conditions are met.

Items.Name: Double Tap Dash
Items.Description: Double-tap the movement control to dash.

Items.Name: Break Sound
Items.Description: Plays a sound when an item breaks.

Items.Name: Show HUD
Items.Description: Shows all active status effects with their icons, remaining time, and detailed information when selected.

Items.Name: Anchor
Items.Description: Sets the anchor position of the HUD on the screen.

Items.Name: Margin X
Items.Description: Adjusts the horizontal offset from the selected anchor position.

Items.Name: Margin Y
Items.Description: Adjusts the vertical offset from the selected anchor position.

Items.Name: Layout Direction
Items.Description: Controls the direction in which the status effect icons are arranged.

Items.Name: Scale
Items.Description: Adjusts the size of the status effect icons.
